headline: **MLB Daily Recap: August 12, 2026**
article:
The Detroit Tigers edged out the Cleveland Guardians 6-4 in a closely contested matchup, with Chase DeLauter leading the Guardians' offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance. The Miami Marlins secured a shutout win over the Pittsburgh Pirates 2-0, with Esteury Ruiz leading the Marlins' offense and Eury Pérez pitching 7 strong innings. The Chicago Cubs outlasted the Washington Nationals 8-6, with Seiya Suzuki leading the offense and Jacob Webb earning the save.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Jake Bloss (Toronto Blue Jays), Riley Greene (Detroit Tigers), Kyle Karros (Colorado Rockies), José Suarez (Athletics), Blake Treinen (Los Angeles Dodgers), Isiah Kiner-Falefa (Boston Red Sox), Kervin Castro (New York Yankees), and Hunter Greene (Cincinnati Reds).

The Baltimore Orioles acquired Harold Rivas from the Boston Red Sox in a trade, while the Kansas City Royals received Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins. The Athletics traded for Seth Johnson from the Philadelphia Phillies, and the Miami Marlins made several trades, including sending Lake Bachar to the Pittsburgh Pirates for Brandan Bidois, Brian Sanchez, and Hyun Seung Lee.

top_news.title: **Tigers Take Down Guardians in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers edged out the Cleveland Guardians 6-4 in a closely contested matchup. Chase DeLauter led the Guardians' offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance.

top_news.title: **Marlins Shut Down Pirates in 2-0 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins took down the Pittsburgh Pirates 2-0, securing a shutout win. Esteury Ruiz led the Marlins' offense with a home run and an RBI, while Eury Pérez pitched 7 strong innings, striking out 7 and allowing 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Cubs Take Down Nationals 8-6**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs secured an 8-6 victory over the Washington Nationals, with Seiya Suzuki leading the offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs. Jacob Webb earned the save, pitching 1.1 innings with 2 strikeouts and no earned runs.

top_news.title: **Mariners Fall Short in Bronx Showdown**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners dropped a 1-4 decision to the New York Yankees in a one-sided contest. Randy Arozarena led the Mariners' offense with a home run and an RBI.

top_news.title: **Twins Take Down Orioles in Thrilling 5-7 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins outlasted the Baltimore Orioles in a high-scoring matchup, securing a 5-7 win. The game saw several impact hitters, including Royce Lewis and Brooks Lee, contribute to the Twins' victory.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Cruise Past Phillies 7-1**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals dominated the Philadelphia Phillies in a one-sided matchup, securing a 7-1 victory. Alec Bohm and Alec Burleson were notable contributors for the Phillies, while Kyle Leahy stood out on the mound for the Cardinals.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays RHP Bloss Lands on 60-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Toronto Blue Jays right-handed pitcher Jake Bloss has been placed on the 60-day injured list, marking a significant update to the team's roster.

top_news.title: **Rivas Joins Orioles in Trade**
top_news.summary: Harold Rivas has been traded to the Baltimore Orioles as part of a deal involving the Boston Red Sox. The trade is related to the August 3 Adley Rutschman trade.
